review.recommendation: The product path of Context Clock v0.3 is accepted by the fixed rule. M 0.906 against R 0.916, M minus R -0.009 (bootstrap interval over tasks -0.108 to +0.107, 12 pairs). Each of the 36 compactions of M has one product delivery of 694 bytes with the hash of the text. M minus B is +0.206 (interval +0.098 to +0.323). The product hook printed 0 bytes in arms A, B and R. The silent clock is open: B 0.700 against A 0.755 over 11 valid pairs, B minus A -0.054 (interval -0.171 to +0.050). With the invalid run of arm A counted as 0.00, the difference is +0.008. The owner decides. Exploratory sample, no significance claim.
